title: VMAFX Helm chart values
description: JSON Schema for deploy/helm/vmafx/values.yaml. Catches typos and invalid enum values at `helm install` / `helm upgrade` / `helm lint` time before they become silent template-rendering bugs.

nameOverride.description: Replaces only the chart-name component of resource names. Default: chart name.

fullnameOverride.description: Replaces the entire resource-name prefix. Default: <release>-<chartName>.

controller.description: vmafx-controller workload: job queue, node API and auth gateway (ADR-1589). store.backend sqlite: one replica on the embedded queue; postgres: any number of replicas on PostgreSQL (ADR-2350).

replicas.description: Controller pods; more than one needs store.backend postgres.

store.description: Where the controller keeps jobs and node sessions (ADR-2350).

cnpg.description: The CloudNativePG Cluster <fullname>-db the chart renders; the operator is a prerequisite.

workload.description: Selects which workload kind the chart renders. Must be one of Deployment, Job, or StatefulSet.

statePVCSize.description: Size of the per-replica PersistentVolumeClaim for MCP session state (/var/lib/vmafx). Standard Kubernetes quantity string (e.g. 1Gi, 500Mi).

extraPorts.description: Additional named Service ports beyond the primary HTTP port.

vendor.description: Maps to the matching device-plugin resource name. nvidia → nvidia.com/gpu, amd → amd.com/gpu, intel → gpu.intel.com/<intelDriver>, cpu → no device plugin. gpu.resourceName overrides it. Vulkan removed per ADR-0726.

intelDriver.description: Kernel driver of the Intel GPUs; the Intel device plugin advertises gpu.intel.com/i915 or gpu.intel.com/xe accordingly. Used only when gpu.vendor is intel.

resourceName.description: Explicit extended-resource name to request (domain/name), overriding vendor and intelDriver; for GPU sharing or MIG resources. Refused with gpu.vendor cpu.

count.description: Number of GPU units to request from the device plugin. Must be ≥1 when gpu.enabled is true; requesting 0 is a silent no-op on every vendor device plugin (ADR-1047).

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: How long Kubernetes waits after SIGTERM before sending SIGKILL. Default 60 s. GPU scoring jobs that cannot checkpoint mid-frame should set 300+ s.

components.description: Which components get a monitor: server, controller and node a ServiceMonitor on their Service, operator a PodMonitor. A component that is not deployed gets none.

prometheusRule.description: The PrometheusRule of the generated alert and recording rules (templates/prometheusrule.yaml).

dashboards.description: One ConfigMap per generated Grafana dashboard (files/dashboards), labelled for the Grafana dashboard sidecar.

gpuExporters.description: Ship the dashboard of a vendor GPU exporter: NVIDIA DCGM (dcgm), AMD device metrics exporter (amd), Intel XPU Manager (intel).

slo.description: SLO objectives: the share of events that must be good over 30 days. The error budget is 1 - objective.

scoreLatencySeconds.description: The latency objective's bound: a bucket bound of vmafx_server_score_duration_seconds, as a string. The enum is checked against metricdef.RequestSecondsBuckets by TestChartSchemaMatchesSettings.

burnRates.description: Multi-window, multi-burn-rate alerting: fast (critical) and slow (warning).

queueAgeSeconds.description: VMAFxQueueAging: how old, in seconds, a tenant's oldest pending job may get.

scoreRegressionPoints.description: VMAFxScoreRegression: the drop, in score points, of an hour's median below the median of the previous day's hourly medians.

scoreRegressionMinScores.description: VMAFxScoreRegression: the scores an hour needs to be compared.

cost.description: Prices of the VMAFx Usage and cost dashboard, the same for every backend (Q-193). 0 is unset: its cost panels stay empty.

perJobSecond.description: Price of one second a node spends on a job.

perJob.description: Price of one completed or failed job; cancelled jobs are not charged.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code shown with the costs, or empty.

mode.description: How vmafx-node reads rclone-remote sources (VMAFX_STORAGE_MODE, pkg/storage). http-serve streams them from a per-job rclone serve http into the scorer; mount reads them from a per-job rclone FUSE mount (needs FUSE in the pod); auto picks mount when FUSE is usable, else http-serve. Local paths and http(s) URLs need no rclone in any mode.

mountRoot.description: Parent directory of mount mode's per-job mount points (VMAFX_STORAGE_MOUNT_ROOT). Empty: the node's temp dir.

strategy.description: Rolling-update strategy for the node Deployment. Default: maxUnavailable:0, maxSurge:1 (zero-disruption, GPU-safe).

grpcPort.description: gRPC listen port for the vmafx-node server. Must match VMAFX_GRPC_LISTEN env var (default 50052). Used for tcpSocket liveness/readiness probes and the node ClusterIP Service.

controllerAddr.description: gRPC host:port of the vmafx-controller, rendered as VMAFX_CONTROLLER_ADDR. Empty: the chart's controller when controller.enabled, else the node stays standalone (direct VmafxScoring only).

metricsPort.description: Prometheus scrape port exposed by vmafx-node. Updates the Deployment containerPort, the node-metrics Service port, and the NetworkPolicy allow rule. Default: 9090.

fuse.description: FUSE in the node pods for storage.mode mount (ADR-1593): a FUSE device plugin's extended resource, SYS_ADMIN and DAC_READ_SEARCH in the capability bounding set for the setuid fusermount3, and an optional AppArmor profile.

resourceName.description: Extended resource a FUSE device plugin advertises for /dev/fuse (squat/generic-device-plugin default domain: devic.es/fuse). Required with enabled.

appArmorProfile.description: Container AppArmor profile; the runtimes' default denies mount. Empty: the runtime default.

ebpf.description: eBPF descriptor tracker (VMAFX_EBPF_BYPASS, ADR-1539, ADR-1593). Needs storage.mode mount and node.fuse.enabled; runs the container as UID 0 with BPF, PERFMON and SYS_ADMIN and mounts /sys/kernel/tracing read-only.

mountPrefix.description: VMAFX_EBPF_MOUNT_PREFIX: absolute path whose opens are recorded; storage.mountRoot must lie under it and defaults to it.

podDisruptionBudget.description: PodDisruptionBudget prevents simultaneous eviction of all pods during voluntary disruptions (ADR-1058). Recommended when replicaCount >= 2.

minAvailable.description: Minimum number (or percentage) of pods that must remain available. Mutually exclusive with maxUnavailable.

maxUnavailable.description: Maximum number (or percentage) of pods that may be unavailable. Mutually exclusive with minAvailable.

networkPolicy.description: NetworkPolicy default-deny posture with allow-rules (ADR-0930). See values.yaml for the full allow.* matrix.

nodePort.description: Node gRPC port the controller may reach; defaults to node.grpcPort.

nodeToController.description: Egress from vmafx-node to the controller's gRPC port, rendered when the nodes have a controller (node.controllerAddr or controller.enabled).

controllerIngress.description: Ingress to the controller's HTTP and gRPC ports (controller.enabled).

operatorToController.description: Egress from the operator to the controller (GetJob, /healthz).

controllerToDatabase.description: Egress from the controller and its migration Job to PostgreSQL (store.backend postgres): the chart's Cluster in cnpg mode, cidrs in external mode.

controllerToIdentityProvider.description: Egress from the controller to the identity providers' JWKS endpoints while auth is on.

serverToApiserver.description: Allow the controller to read VmafxTenant resources from the kube-apiserver (ADR-1519).

nodeMetrics.description: Allow Prometheus to scrape vmafx-node metrics port 9090 (ADR-1058).

metricsScrape.description: Allow Prometheus to scrape every component's metrics port while monitoring.enabled (ADR-2349): server and controller HTTP, node metrics, operator 8080. fromNamespaceSelector admits a Prometheus in another namespace.

auth.description: Multi-tenant JWT/OIDC gateway (ADR-0794). additionalProperties:true to accommodate per-tenant oidc and rbac sub-keys without exhaustive enumeration.

scoringRoots.description: Inputs callers may score without a tenant registry (VMAFX_SCORING_ROOTS, ADR-1577); {tenant} becomes the caller's tenant ID; empty refuses every input.

otelCollector.description: OpenTelemetry collector sidecar (ADR-0782). additionalProperties:true to allow arbitrary receiver/exporter config blocks.

sloObjective.description: An SLO objective: the share of good events, strictly between 0 and 1 (0.99 = 99 %).

promDuration.description: A Prometheus duration such as 5m, 1h or 1h30m.

burnRate.description: One burn-rate rule: the ratio of bad events over longWindow and over shortWindow both above factor * (1 - objective), for the for duration.

durationOrEmpty.description: A Go duration such as 30s or 2m; empty keeps the program's default.

tokenSecretSpec.description: A Secret key holding a bearer token for the controller, mounted read-only and passed as VMAFX_CONTROLLER_TOKEN_FILE.
